x-values.credential: a CLI, SNMP or HTTP login (secrets from a file)
x-values.classic_device: a device in the collection list: add, update, delete, or test its connectivity
x-values.endpoint: an endpoint (a Linux host or other source) and the profile it uses
x-values.cloud_account: a cloud account: add, rotate, test, delete
x-values.controller_setup: a controller-managed setup (SD-WAN, ACI): create, migrate classic devices into it, test it, move its collector
x-values.custom_command_group: commands (or OIDs) a network adds to a device type's collection: create, update, disable, delete
x-values.discovery: device discovery: start or stop a scan (it probes the network), add what it found, schedule it

name.description: credential delete: the credential id; proxy update: the proxy id; classic_device update or delete: the device name; schedule update or delete: the schedule id; cloud_account update, rotate, test or delete: the account name; controller_setup or mist_setup update or delete: the setup name

definition.description: the non-secret body; see Input details in `fwdctl run edit-source --help`. A secret-looking field is refused

secret_file.description: path of a file (mode 600) holding the secret, or a JSON object of named secrets for SNMP v3

secret_env.description: name of an environment variable holding the secret (instead of secret_file)

confirm.description: credential delete: the exact credential id; classic_device delete: the device name; jump_server delete: the jump server id; rapid7_source delete: the source name; schedule delete: the schedule id; cloud_account delete: the account name; controller_setup or mist_setup delete: the setup name
